items.description:
### Issue/Question

The `Software Engineer - New Grad` role at Stripe has valid links for `London` and `Toronto`, but the link for
```
Seattle, WA
SF
NYC
```

Leads nowhere. The job also cannot be found on Stripe's [job portal.](https://stripe.com/careers/search?query=new+grad)

items.title: [ $ cạnh tranh ] Senior Android Engineer [5+ yoe] - HCM Hybrid  (JobID: IT-565)
items.description:
[ $inbox trao đổi 1-1 ] Senior Android Engineer [5+ yoe] - HCM Hybrid - Cty Digital Banking - ENG fluent (JobID: IT-565)

We are looking for a Senior Android Software Engineer to help shape the next generation of mobile banking experience.

You will build reliable, secure, and high-performing Android applications that power critical financial experiences for our customers. Working closely with Product, Design, Backend, QA, and Security, you will contribute to our mobile architecture, engineering standards, and release reliability, while helping evolve our long-term mobile direction alongside regional teams.

You will report to our Lead Android Engineer.
● Build and evolve the Android app powering digital banking experience
● Design and deliver reliable, secure mobile features across payments, onboarding, transfers, and savings
● Drive engineering quality through clean architecture, testing, and operational excellence
● Collaborate closely with Product, Design, Backend, QA, and Security to ship customer-centric solutions
● Mentor mid and junior engineers through code reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing
● Contribute to technical direction, architectural decisions, engineering standards, and modern Android practices.

UV qtam liên hệ mình zl o332.o22.o55 hoặc techdy.vn@gmail.com với jobID là IT-565 nhé.
IB mình nếu bạn quan tâm các vị trí khác đang open lĩnh vực IT, Data & AI (đang open 100+ vị trí từ Middle đến Lead++).
